stemMd: What is the purpose of the temporary meters in the procedure?

options.label: A
options.textMd: To prove that hospitals use no water

options.label: B
options.textMd: To eliminate the need for further investigation

options.label: C
options.textMd: To replace all consumption records permanently

options.label: E
options.textMd: To localise the remaining unexplained flow

explanationMd: After accounting for major users, temporary meters narrow the area where residual flow persists. Their role is spatial localisation of the unresolved signal.

distractorRationale.c: The passage does not propose this replacement.
distractorRationale.d: Demand stimulation is not their role.
